title: 第66章 会哭会闹的孩子有糖吃

第66章 会哭会闹的孩子有糖吃-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

林海柱走了。

背影佝偻着，在夕阳里拉得很长。

林国强坐在院子里，看着桌上那个布包，半天没动。

赵素梅从屋里出来，轻声问：“爹走了？”

“嗯。”

“爹说啥了？”

林国强把布包推给她：“给咱买了台蝴蝶牌缝纫机。”

赵素梅打开布包，看见票据，眼眶一下子就红了。

不是因为东西值多少钱。

是因为，这是老宅那边头一回，正儿八经地给老二家补了点啥。

“爹心里还是有数的。”赵素梅小声说。

林国强没说话。

他知道林海柱比李红霞强点，但也仅仅是强点。

这些年他沉默着，看着李红霞偏心，看着老大老三占便宜，他什么都知道，但什么都没管。

现在知道补了，是因为他闹了。

不闹，什么都没有。

果然，还是会哭会闹的孩子有糖吃。

“收着吧。”林国强站起来，“该咱的。”

老宅那边，李红霞正在炕上躺着，脸色蜡黄。

林海柱进门的时候，她腾地坐起来：“你真给老二买缝纫机了？”

“买了。”

“你……”李红霞拍着炕沿，“你疯了？咱手里还有几个钱？”

林海柱在炕边坐下，闷声道：“给老大家买了手表，给老三买了电视机，老二有啥？”

“他不是开店挣钱了吗？”

“那是他自己挣的。”林海柱抬起头，“跟咱给的有啥关系？”

李红霞被噎住了。

“你偏心老大老三，我不说啥。”

林海柱磕着烟袋，“但老二也是咱儿子，人家闹了，你才给，那是被逼的。

不闹之前给，那才叫当爹妈的。”

“咱手里的钱，给老大买手表，给老三买电视机，给老二买缝纫机。”他叹了口气，“快掏空了。”

李红霞脸色一变：“掏空了？”

“还剩不到二百块。”

李红霞瘫在炕上，半晌没说话。

二百块，在1981年说少不少，说多也不多。

但老两口没了进项，这点钱就是棺材本。

Lin Haizhu is gone.

The back was hunched and stretched very long in the sunset.

Lin Guoqiang sat in the yard and looked at the cloth bag on the table without moving it for a long time.

Zhao Sumei came out of the house and asked softly: "Dad is gone?"

"Yeah."

"What did dad say?"

Lin Guoqiang pushed the cloth bag to her: "I bought us a butterfly sewing machine."

Zhao Sumei opened the cloth bag and saw the receipt, her eyes suddenly turned red.

Not because of how much something is worth.

It's because this is the first time that the old man's house has seriously made up for the second son's family.

"Dad still knows what's going on." Zhao Sumei whispered.

Lin Guoqiang said nothing.

He knew that Lin Haizhu was stronger than Li Hongxia, but only stronger.

Over the years, he remained silent, watching Li Hongxia play favorites and watching the boss and the third take advantage. He knew everything but didn't care about anything.

Now I know it’s because he made trouble.

No fuss, nothing.

Sure enough, the children who still cry and make noises get candy.

"Just keep it." Lin Guoqiang stood up, "It's our turn."

Over at the old house, Li Hongxia was lying on the kang, her face sallow.

When Lin Haizhu came in, she sat up and said, "Did you really buy a sewing machine for your second son?"

"Bought."

"You..." Li Hongxia patted the edge of the kang, "Are you crazy? How much money do we still have?"

Lin Haizhu sat down by the Kang and said in a low voice: "I bought a watch for the elder brother and a TV for the third child. What does the second child have?"

"Didn't he make money by opening a shop?"

"That's what he earned himself." Lin Haizhu raised his head, "What does it have to do with what we gave him?"

Li Hongxia was choked.

"You favor the boss and the third child, so I won't say anything."

Lin Haizhu puffed on his pipe, "But the second son is also our son. You only gave it to me when someone made trouble. You were forced to do so.

If you don't give it before you make a fuss, that's what you call being a parent."

"The money we have is used to buy a watch for the eldest brother, a TV for the third child, and a sewing machine for the second child." He sighed, "It's almost gone."

Li Hongxia's expression changed: "Empty it?"

"Less than two hundred dollars left."

Li Hongxia collapsed on the kang and didn't speak for a long time.

Two hundred yuan was a lot less in 1981, but a lot more than it was.

But the old couple had no income, and this little money was just a coffin book.
